idea.name: Tine
idea.one_liner: Strobe-disc chromatic tuner for anyone who tunes by ear for a living: cent-accurate drift, historical temperaments, transposition and a sustained reference drone.
idea.why_organic: Strobe Tuner Pro nearly doubled its modelled installs between mid 2023 and 2026 and still adds about nine ratings a month at $4.99, the clearest growth curve of any paid tool anchor measured, which means the query converts paid traffic today rather than in 2016. 'Chromatic Tuner Pro' is 19 characters and the modifier searches ('tuner no ads', 'tuner offline') are exactly the intent a paid listing answers.
idea.incumbents: Strobe Tuner Pro at $4.99 with 50K+ installs and 4.5 on 1,302 ratings, gStrings at about $10 and 4.7, A-Tuner at $2.49 and 4.9 on a small base. The free field is ad-funded needle tuners that interrupt between notes and mostly refuse to resolve better than a few cents, which is useless for intonation work, reed tuning or setting a harmonium.
idea.differentiation: A true rotating strobe disc rendered at display refresh rate instead of a bouncing needle, so drift is visible to a fraction of a cent; plus the things a working musician needs and free apps skip: seven historical and just temperaments, transposing instruments, adjustable A reference from 415 to 466 Hz, a sustained drone to tune against, and a rehearsal drift chart showing how far a wind section sagged over an hour.
core_features: Rotating strobe disc with sub-cent resolution and a needle mode for beginners
Adjustable reference pitch from 415 to 466 Hz, remembered per instrument
Equal, just, Pythagorean, meantone, Kirnberger, Werckmeister and custom cent offsets
Transposing instrument presets (B flat, E flat, F, G) and written versus sounding display
Sustained sine, sawtooth and reed drone on any note for tuning by beats
Instrument profiles for guitar, violin family, brass, reeds, harmonium and tabla-adjacent ranges
Rehearsal drift chart: record pitch of a held note over minutes and see the sag
Noise gate and adjustable input sensitivity for loud rooms
Full-screen tuning display for a music stand, landscape and tablet layouts
Session export of tuning readings as CSV
idea.build_note: Oboe or AudioRecord input at 48 kHz, YIN or autocorrelation pitch detection with a parabolic interpolation refinement, strobe disc drawn on Compose Canvas driven by the detected phase, oscillator drone through AudioTrack, DataStore presets, Room for drift sessions. RECORD_AUDIO only, no storage of audio. About 4 weeks, DSP tuning is the cost.
idea.policy_note: RECORD_AUDIO with an in-context explanation and no recording ever written to disk, which keeps the Data safety form at no collection. No INTERNET, no foreground service since tuning is a foreground activity.
idea.evidence: Velocity research found Strobe Tuner Pro the healthiest paid tool anchor measured: modelled installs grew from 28.6K in mid 2023 to 52.6K by 2026 and it still adds about nine ratings a month at $4.99, while the rest of the paid tuner field is a $2.49 to $10 spread with thin review bases. https://play.google.com/store/search?q=guitar%20tuner&c=apps&price=2

scorecards.note: Strobe Tuner Pro is the healthiest paid tool anchor measured and a rotating strobe disc is a difference a screenshot can show.
Strobe Tuner Pro is the healthiest growth curve measured, but it is a 4.5 incumbent on the exact term the map says not to hit head on.
Strobe Tuner Pro is the healthiest paid tool anchor measured and a rotating strobe disc is the rare DSP feature that screenshots well.

refutation.reason: Demand is proven and the app works fully offline with low policy risk, but the organic upfront-paid claim does not hold as pitched. Nearly every differentiator in the brief is already free on Play. gStrings (free, 10M+, 4.7 on 237K ratings, updated Jul 2026) ships just, Pythagorean, meantone and custom temperaments, orchestra A shift and a pitch pipe, with ads light enough that it holds 4.7. Airyware Tuner (100K+, 4.3, updated Nov 2025) is usable free forever with a 30 second nag and lists true strobe mode, 0.1 cent accuracy, A4 300 to 600 Hz, scale transposition, customizable temperaments, stretched tunings, a tone generator and 400+ instruments, which is a superset of the Tine feature list. StroboPro (free with IAP, 10K+, 4.8, updated Sep 8 2026) does harmonic-tracking strobes and a pitch pipe, and Moessner's open-source Tuner (free, no ads, 10K+, 4.7) has Werckmeister, Kirnberger, EDO temperaments and a pitch-over-time graph. The 'strobe disc screenshots well' edge is therefore not unique: page one for 'strobe tuner' already shows four strobe listings, two of them free. On 'chromatic tuner' page one is 9 of 10 free, led by BOSS, Pitched (1M+, 4.7), Pano Tuner (1M+, 4.5) and Soundcorset (50M+, 4.5). The paid field has about a dozen credible listings and the anchor itself is modest: Strobe Tuner Pro 50K+ at $4.99 with 1.31K ratings and roughly 9 new ratings a month, so a no-brand newcomer at 10 to 30 percent of that velocity is on the order of 30 to 150 sales a month. What survives is a narrow wedge: the paid-filter and 'tuner no ads' intent, where the buyer wants a one-time price, no nag, and the drone plus drift chart that only TonalEnergy ($5.99, 100K+, 4.3) partly covers. The name fails: 'Tine: Notification Sounds' (com.polyhistor.tine) is a paid $1.99 sound app updated Sep 10 2026, plus Tine Health, EWR 'tine', and TINE is a major Norwegian dairy trademark.
refutation.store_evidence: Play search fetched 2026-09-13 (US). 'strobe tuner' all: Peterson Strobe $9.99 3.9, StroboPro free 4.8, Strobe Tuner Pro $4.99 4.5, Airyware free-trial 4.3, Harmonic Tuner Strobe Look $0.99, TonalEnergy $5.99, Moessner Tuner free 4.7, Soundcorset, Fender, Tuneo, Simply Tune, Pitched. 'strobe tuner' paid filter: 12 listings (Peterson, Strobe Tuner Pro, Grain Apps x2, TonalEnergy, gStrings $10, StringSync, A-Tuner $2.49, Instrument Tuner Pro $1.99, Tuner Lite Pro $4.99, Ultimate Tuner Pro $9.99, n-Track $13.99). 'chromatic tuner' all: 9 of 10 free (Gaston, BOSS, Pitched, Soundcorset, Bialamusic, Pano, CarlTune, Astronote, SoloTuner) plus TonalEnergy. 'tuner no ads' all: Moessner Tuner, Fender, Soundcorset, Pitched, GuitarTuna, Simply; paid filter led by TonalEnergy and A-Tuner. 'violin tuner offline' and 'harmonium tuner' return generic free tuners, no harmonium-specific incumbent, weak separate demand. Listing HTML: gStrings free 10M+ 4.7 237K Jul 9 2026 contains ads; gStrings paid 50K+ 4.7 4.39K $10; Pitched 1M+ 4.7 33.6K; Pano 1M+ 4.5 41.2K; Airyware 100K+ 4.3 1.5K; StroboPro 10K+ 4.8 166; Strobe Tuner Pro 50K+ 4.5 1.31K May 11 2026. F-Droid and web roundups point ad-averse users to the free open-source Tuner with strobe and 32 temperaments.

sharpen.short_80: Sub-cent strobe tuner with temperaments, drone and drift chart. No ads, offline.
must_have: Strobe disc at display refresh rate with a needle fallback, readable at arm's length on a music stand
Sustained drone on any note (sine, reed, saw) that keeps sounding while the tuner listens, the feature free strobe apps lack
Rehearsal drift chart of a held note over minutes, exportable as CSV
Adjustable A from 415 to 466 Hz per instrument profile, transposing presets for B flat, E flat and F
Equal, just, Pythagorean, quarter-comma meantone, Werckmeister III, Kirnberger III and custom cents
Noise gate for loud rooms and a harmonium or reed profile for held tones
No INTERNET permission stated in the listing, no nag, no IAP, one price
cut: Tabla-adjacent ranges, not a pitch-tuner use case and a misleading promise
400+ instrument database race with Airyware; ship 15 good profiles
Harmonic-by-harmonic strobes, StroboPro owns that and it doubles DSP time
Violin tuner offline and harmonium tuner as separate keyword pushes; they are generic free-tuner queries
sharpen.positioning: The one-price, nag-free strobe tuner for ensemble players who tune against a drone and watch pitch drift, not another guitar needle.

note: The refutation is adversarial by design and marks nearly everything refuted. Read its evidence, competitors and sharpen block: they set the positioning, must-haves, cuts and price. A strong free incumbent must be answered concretely in BLUEPRINT.md section 2.
